title: Tarot card data: all 78 cards
attribution: Tarot card data by Taro's Tarot (https://tarostarot.com/tarot-card-data), CC BY 4.0
images: Card images: scans of the 1909 Rider-Waite-Smith deck (Pamela Colman Smith), public domain.

cards.name: The Fool
cards.upright: New beginnings, unlimited potential, and a leap of faith into the unknown.
cards.reversed: Recklessness, poor judgment, or fear of taking necessary risks.

yes_no.summary: A yes for the leap itself; the landing is not shown yet

cards.name: The Magician
cards.upright: Manifestation, resourcefulness, and the power to create your reality through focused will.
cards.reversed: Manipulation, illusion, or untapped potential waiting to be properly channeled.

yes_no.summary: Yes: everything you need is already on the table

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.upright: Trust your intuition and look beyond the obvious to find hidden truths and inner wisdom.
cards.reversed: Blocked intuition, revealed secrets, or ignoring your inner voice.

yes_no.summary: Yes, but the part you cannot see yet decides how

cards.name: The Empress
cards.upright: Abundance, nurturing, fertility, and the flourishing of all creative endeavors.
cards.reversed: Creative blocks, neglect, codependence, or smothering behavior.

yes_no.summary: Yes: growth, comfort and things coming to fruit

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.upright: Authority, structure, leadership, and the establishment of order from chaos.
cards.reversed: Tyranny, rigidity, domination, or alternatively, weakness and lack of discipline.

yes_no.summary: Yes, through structure, rules and steady authority

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.upright: Traditional values, spiritual guidance, education, and conformity to established systems.
cards.reversed: Challenging tradition, unconventional approaches, or rigid dogma blocking growth.

yes_no.summary: Yes by the established route, no to shortcuts

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.upright: Love, harmony, partnerships, and important choices between different paths or values.
cards.reversed: Relationship disharmony, poor choices, or internal conflicts about values.

yes_no.summary: Yes when the choice is honest; the card is a choice as much as a match

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.upright: Victory through willpower, determination, and the ability to control opposing forces.
cards.reversed: Lack of control, scattered energy, or being pulled in conflicting directions.

yes_no.summary: Yes, won by will and keeping both hands on the reins

cards.name: Strength
cards.upright: Inner strength, courage, and the power to overcome challenges through patience and love.
cards.reversed: Lack of inner strength, being overwhelmed, or misuse of power.

yes_no.summary: A patient yes: steady nerve wins over force

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.upright: Soul searching, seeking inner wisdom, and the need for solitude and introspection.
cards.reversed: Isolation, stubbornness, or avoiding necessary inner work.

yes_no.summary: No for now: the lantern is for looking, not leaping

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.upright: A turning point in life, good fortune, and alignment with destiny.
cards.reversed: Setbacks, resistance to change, or feeling out of control with life's cycles.

yes_no.summary: Yes: the turn is in your favour, so move while it is

cards.name: Justice
cards.upright: Balance, fairness, accountability, and the law of cause and effect in action.
cards.reversed: Injustice, imbalance, lack of accountability, or avoiding consequences.

yes_no.summary: Yes if your case is fair; the scales do not take sides

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.upright: Surrender, sacrifice, gaining new perspective through letting go and waiting.
cards.reversed: Resistance to surrender, feeling stuck, or unnecessary self-sacrifice.

yes_no.summary: No for action; yes only to waiting and seeing differently

cards.name: Death
cards.upright: Transformation, necessary endings, and rebirth into a new phase of life.
cards.reversed: Resistance to change, fear of transformation, or incomplete endings.

yes_no.summary: No to keeping things as they are; the change is the answer

cards.name: Temperance
cards.upright: Balance, moderation, patience, and the harmonious blending of opposing forces.
cards.reversed: Imbalance, extremes, impatience, or inability to find harmony.

yes_no.summary: Yes, through patience, blending and the middle path

cards.name: The Devil
cards.upright: Bondage to material desires, temptation, and the illusion of being trapped.
cards.reversed: Breaking free from bondage, overcoming addiction, or recognizing personal freedom.

yes_no.summary: No: the chains are loose, but you are still wearing them

cards.name: The Tower
cards.upright: Sudden change, spiritual awakening, and liberation through destruction of false foundations.
cards.reversed: Resistance to change, avoiding necessary upheaval, or gradual transformation.

yes_no.summary: No: what is being asked about will not survive the shock

cards.name: The Star
cards.upright: Hope, inspiration, spiritual guidance, and renewed faith after difficult times.
cards.reversed: Lack of faith, disconnection from guidance, or dreams deferred.

yes_no.summary: Yes: hope with a reason behind it

cards.name: The Moon
cards.upright: Illusion, intuition, unconscious fears, and navigating through uncertainty.
cards.reversed: Clarity emerging from confusion, overcoming illusions, or suppressed intuition.

yes_no.summary: No for now: nothing here is what it looks like

cards.name: The Sun
cards.upright: Joy, success, vitality, and the achievement of happiness and enlightenment.
cards.reversed: Temporary clouds over success, delayed happiness, or difficulty accessing joy.

yes_no.summary: Yes: the clearest yes in the deck

cards.name: Judgement
cards.upright: Spiritual rebirth, inner calling, awakening to higher purpose, and divine evaluation.
cards.reversed: Resistance to spiritual calling, harsh self-judgment, or delayed awakening.

yes_no.summary: Yes: a call you already know how to answer

cards.name: The World
cards.upright: Completion, fulfillment, achievement of goals, and cosmic consciousness.
cards.reversed: Incomplete goals, seeking external completion, or resistance to wholeness.

yes_no.summary: Yes: completion, success and the circle closing

cards.name: Ace of Wands
cards.upright: A new creative or spiritual beginning filled with passionate energy and unlimited potential.
cards.reversed: Blocked creativity, false starts, or misdirected energy preventing progress.

yes_no.summary: Yes: a new spark with real growth on it

cards.name: Two of Wands
cards.upright: Planning for the future, taking control of your destiny, and preparing for expansion.
cards.reversed: Lack of planning, fear of change, or waiting too long to take action.

yes_no.summary: Yes, once you stop surveying and choose a direction

cards.name: Three of Wands
cards.upright: Expansion of horizons, progress on long-term goals, and opportunities from afar.
cards.reversed: Lack of foresight, delays in progress, or missed opportunities for expansion.

yes_no.summary: Yes: what you sent out is on its way back

cards.name: Four of Wands
cards.upright: A time of celebration, harmony, and achievement after hard work and dedication.
cards.reversed: Cancelled celebrations, lack of harmony, or delays in achieving stability.

yes_no.summary: Yes: celebration, stability and a place to come home to

cards.name: Five of Wands
cards.upright: Competition, creative tension, and challenges that ultimately lead to growth.
cards.reversed: Avoiding conflict, inner tension, or competition turning destructive.

yes_no.summary: No: too many hands on the wand, no agreed direction

cards.name: Six of Wands
cards.upright: Victory, public recognition, and well-deserved success after overcoming challenges.
cards.reversed: Lack of recognition, private victories, or success without acknowledgment.

yes_no.summary: Yes: a win, and a win other people can see

cards.name: Seven of Wands
cards.upright: Defending your position, standing your ground, and persevering against challenges.
cards.reversed: Giving up too easily, being overwhelmed by challenges, or lack of confidence in your position.

yes_no.summary: Yes, if you hold your ground; the high ground is yours

cards.name: Eight of Wands
cards.upright: Swift action, rapid progress, and momentum building toward your goals.
cards.reversed: Delays, blocked communication, or impatience with slow progress.

yes_no.summary: Yes, and fast: things are already in motion

cards.name: Nine of Wands
cards.upright: Resilience in the face of challenges, persistence despite setbacks, and guarding your achievements.
cards.reversed: Giving up too early, excessive defensiveness, or being overwhelmed by challenges.

yes_no.summary: Yes, nearly there: one more stand and it holds

cards.name: Ten of Wands
cards.upright: Heavy responsibilities, hard work paying off, and approaching the completion of a major goal.
cards.reversed: Releasing burdens, delegating responsibilities, or avoiding necessary commitments.

yes_no.summary: No: the load is too heavy to carry as it is

cards.name: Page of Wands
cards.upright: Enthusiastic exploration, creative inspiration, and messages about new opportunities.
cards.reversed: Lack of direction, impulsiveness, or blocked creative messages.

yes_no.summary: Yes: good news, a new spark, an eager start

cards.name: Knight of Wands
cards.upright: Swift action, passionate pursuit of goals, and fearless adventure.
cards.reversed: Recklessness, impulsiveness without direction, or frustrated action.

yes_no.summary: Yes, at full speed; aim before you charge

cards.name: Queen of Wands
cards.upright: Confident leadership, charismatic personality, and the ability to inspire and attract others.
cards.reversed: Lack of confidence, jealousy, or using charm manipulatively.

yes_no.summary: Yes: confidence attracts the result

cards.name: King of Wands
cards.upright: Masterful leadership, visionary thinking, and the ability to inspire others to achieve great things.
cards.reversed: Authoritarian behavior, abuse of power, or inability to lead effectively.

yes_no.summary: Yes, with leadership and a long view

cards.name: Ace of Cups
cards.upright: New emotional beginnings, spiritual awakening, and overflowing love and compassion.
cards.reversed: Emotional blockages, repressed feelings, or difficulty expressing or receiving love.

yes_no.summary: Yes: a new feeling, offered freely

cards.name: Two of Cups
cards.upright: Harmonious partnerships, mutual connections, and the joy of shared emotional experiences.
cards.reversed: Relationship disharmony, imbalanced partnerships, or disconnection from others.

yes_no.summary: Yes: mutual, matched and meant to be shared

cards.name: Three of Cups
cards.upright: Celebration, friendship, and the joy of community and creative collaboration.
cards.reversed: Social conflicts, isolation from community, or superficial relationships lacking depth.

yes_no.summary: Yes: celebration, friends and good news shared

cards.name: Four of Cups
cards.upright: Contemplation, emotional withdrawal, and the need to reassess current situations and opportunities.
cards.reversed: Renewed motivation, accepting opportunities, or emerging from a period of apathy and withdrawal.

yes_no.summary: No for now: the offer is there and you are not looking at it

cards.name: Five of Cups
cards.upright: Loss, grief, and disappointment, but with hope for recovery and lessons to be learned.
cards.reversed: Recovery from loss, acceptance of past disappointments, or moving forward with renewed hope.

yes_no.summary: No: grief is in charge, with two cups still standing

cards.name: Six of Cups
cards.upright: Nostalgia, childhood memories, and finding healing and joy through connections to the past.
cards.reversed: Living in the past, inability to move forward, or romanticizing memories unhealthily.

yes_no.summary: Yes: kindness, familiarity and something from the past returning

cards.name: Seven of Cups
cards.upright: Multiple options creating confusion, illusions, and the need to distinguish between realistic goals and fantasies.
cards.reversed: Gaining clarity, making decisive choices, or coming down from illusions to face reality.

yes_no.summary: No: too many options and none of them chosen

cards.name: Eight of Cups
cards.upright: Spiritual seeking, abandoning what no longer serves, and embarking on a journey for deeper meaning.
cards.reversed: Fear of abandoning security, avoiding necessary change, or returning to what was left behind.

yes_no.summary: No: the honest answer is to walk away

cards.name: Nine of Cups
cards.upright: Emotional fulfillment, satisfaction, wishes coming true, and deep personal contentment.
cards.reversed: Inner dissatisfaction, unrealistic expectations, or superficial happiness that lacks depth.

yes_no.summary: Yes: the wish card, and the wish is granted

cards.name: Ten of Cups
cards.upright: Complete emotional fulfillment, family harmony, and the achievement of lasting happiness.
cards.reversed: Family discord, unrealistic relationship expectations, or temporary disruption of harmony.

yes_no.summary: Yes: lasting happiness, family and a home that holds

cards.name: Page of Cups
cards.upright: Emotional messages, creative inspiration, and openness to intuitive guidance and new emotional experiences.
cards.reversed: Blocked creativity, emotional immaturity, or ignoring intuitive messages and inner guidance.

yes_no.summary: Yes: a gentle surprise, a message, a feeling spoken

cards.name: Knight of Cups
cards.upright: Following your heart, pursuing dreams with passion, and taking action based on emotional truth.
cards.reversed: Unrealistic dreams, emotional manipulation, or acting on emotion without considering consequences.

yes_no.summary: Yes: an offer made from the heart, arriving slowly

cards.name: Queen of Cups
cards.upright: Emotional mastery, intuitive wisdom, and the ability to nurture and heal through compassionate understanding.
cards.reversed: Emotional overwhelm, codependency, or losing boundaries in attempts to help others.

yes_no.summary: Yes: kindness and intuition lead to the right result

cards.name: King of Cups
cards.upright: Emotional mastery, wise leadership, and the ability to remain calm and balanced in turbulent situations.
cards.reversed: Emotional manipulation, moodiness affecting leadership, or suppressed feelings leading to control issues.

yes_no.summary: Yes, through calm and composure; the sea is rough and the throne is steady

cards.name: Ace of Swords
cards.upright: Mental clarity, breakthrough insights, and the power of truth to cut through confusion.
cards.reversed: Mental confusion, blocked insights, or misuse of intellectual power.

yes_no.summary: Yes: clarity cuts through, and the truth favours you

cards.name: Two of Swords
cards.upright: Mental stalemate, difficult decisions requiring careful consideration, and the need to remove mental blindfolds.
cards.reversed: Breaking through indecision, gaining clarity, or making necessary but difficult choices.

yes_no.summary: No: a stalemate held in place by a blindfold

cards.name: Three of Swords
cards.upright: Heartbreak, emotional pain, and the necessary process of grieving loss or betrayal.
cards.reversed: Healing from heartbreak, releasing pain, or moving forward after emotional trauma.

yes_no.summary: No: heartbreak is the subject, and healing is the sequel

cards.name: Four of Swords
cards.upright: Mental rest, strategic pause, and the need for contemplation before taking action.
cards.reversed: Restlessness, inability to rest, or emerging from a period of contemplation ready for action.

yes_no.summary: No for now: rest first, then the answer

cards.name: Five of Swords
cards.upright: Conflict, defeat, and hollow victories that come at too high a cost.
cards.reversed: Learning from defeat, releasing competitive patterns, or seeking reconciliation.

yes_no.summary: No: a win that costs more than it is worth

cards.name: Six of Swords
cards.upright: Transition from difficulties, gradual healing, and guided journey toward better times.
cards.reversed: Resistance to change, delayed transition, or difficulty accepting help.

yes_no.summary: Yes: a quiet crossing to calmer water

cards.name: Seven of Swords
cards.upright: Deception, theft, strategic thinking, or getting away with questionable behavior.
cards.reversed: Getting caught, confession, or choosing honesty over deception.

yes_no.summary: No: something is being taken or hidden

cards.name: Eight of Swords
cards.upright: Mental imprisonment, self-limiting beliefs, and feeling trapped by circumstances or thinking patterns.
cards.reversed: Breaking free from mental imprisonment, recognizing options, or taking steps toward liberation.

yes_no.summary: No for now: bound loosely, blindfolded, and free to leave

cards.name: Nine of Swords
cards.upright: Anxiety, worry, and mental anguish causing sleepless nights and psychological distress.
cards.reversed: Recovery from anxiety, overcoming worry, or finding relief from mental anguish.

yes_no.summary: No: the fear is real, the thing feared mostly is not

cards.name: Ten of Swords
cards.upright: Rock bottom, complete defeat, but also the end of a painful cycle and promise of new beginnings.
cards.reversed: Recovery from rock bottom, avoiding complete defeat, or gradual healing from trauma.

yes_no.summary: No: it is over, and the dawn behind it is real

cards.name: Page of Swords
cards.upright: Mental clarity, intellectual curiosity, and eagerness to learn and communicate new ideas.
cards.reversed: Mental scattered energy, gossip, or using intellect for harmful purposes.

yes_no.summary: Yes: curiosity, a message and sharp new information

cards.name: Knight of Swords
cards.upright: Quick action on ideas, charging ahead with determination, but potentially lacking patience for planning.
cards.reversed: Reckless actions, poor communication, or scattered mental energy causing problems.

yes_no.summary: Yes, fast and blunt; mind what the charge knocks over

cards.name: Queen of Swords
cards.upright: Sharp intellect, clear communication, and wise discernment gained through life experience.
cards.reversed: Harsh criticism, cold communication, or using intellect as a weapon.

yes_no.summary: Yes, on honest terms: clear eyes, clear words

cards.name: King of Swords
cards.upright: Mental authority, intellectual leadership, and the ability to make fair decisions through logical analysis.
cards.reversed: Authoritarian behavior, harsh judgment, or misuse of intellectual power.

yes_no.summary: Yes, by logic and authority: the ruling is sound

cards.name: Ace of Pentacles
cards.upright: A golden opportunity for material abundance and financial prosperity is being offered.
cards.reversed: Missed opportunities, poor financial decisions, or lack of practical planning.

yes_no.summary: Yes: a solid opportunity, offered and real

cards.name: Two of Pentacles
cards.upright: Successfully juggling multiple responsibilities while maintaining balance and adaptability.
cards.reversed: Overwhelmed by too many responsibilities, poor time management, or lack of prioritization.

yes_no.summary: Yes, if you can keep both in the air

cards.name: Three of Pentacles
cards.upright: Success through teamwork, collaboration, and the sharing of skills and expertise.
cards.reversed: Lack of teamwork, conflicts in collaboration, or working alone when partnership is needed.

yes_no.summary: Yes, through teamwork and skill recognised

cards.name: Four of Pentacles
cards.upright: A focus on security and stability through careful conservation and control of resources.
cards.reversed: Excessive materialism, greed, or the opposite extreme of reckless spending and insecurity.

yes_no.summary: No: holding on too tightly for anything to move

cards.name: Five of Pentacles
cards.upright: A period of financial hardship or spiritual poverty that requires seeking support and help.
cards.reversed: Recovery from hardship, receiving help, or beginning to overcome difficulties.

yes_no.summary: No: hardship for now, with help nearby and unasked for

cards.name: Six of Pentacles
cards.upright: A time of balanced giving and receiving, generosity, and sharing abundance with others.
cards.reversed: Imbalanced giving and receiving, strings attached to generosity, or misuse of power.

yes_no.summary: Yes: generosity flows, and the scales stay fair

cards.name: Seven of Pentacles
cards.upright: A time of assessment and patience as your long-term investments begin to show results.
cards.reversed: Impatience with results, poor long-term planning, or abandoning projects too early.

yes_no.summary: Yes, in time: the crop is growing and not yet picked

cards.name: Eight of Pentacles
cards.upright: Dedication to mastering your craft through focused effort and attention to detail.
cards.reversed: Perfectionism, lack of focus, or poor work quality undermining success.

yes_no.summary: Yes, through practice: skill is being built coin by coin

cards.name: Nine of Pentacles
cards.upright: Enjoying the fruits of your labor through abundance, luxury, and self-sufficient independence.
cards.reversed: Financial setbacks, dependence on others, or inability to enjoy earned success.

yes_no.summary: Yes: independence, comfort and the reward already earned

cards.name: Ten of Pentacles
cards.upright: The completion of material success and the creation of lasting wealth and security for future generations.
cards.reversed: Family conflicts over money, loss of wealth, or failure to create lasting security.

yes_no.summary: Yes: lasting wealth, family and something that outlives you

cards.name: Page of Pentacles
cards.upright: A student of practical wisdom, learning opportunities, and messages about material manifestation.
cards.reversed: Lack of focus in learning, missed opportunities, or impractical approaches to material matters.

yes_no.summary: Yes: a practical opportunity worth studying

cards.name: Knight of Pentacles
cards.upright: Methodical progress through hard work, routine, and persistent dedication to your goals.
cards.reversed: Stagnation, stubbornness, or excessive focus on routine without progress or flexibility.

yes_no.summary: Yes, slowly and surely: the field gets ploughed

cards.name: Queen of Pentacles
cards.upright: Nurturing abundance through practical wisdom, generosity, and caring provision for others.
cards.reversed: Neglecting self-care, financial insecurity, or becoming overly controlling in caring for others.

yes_no.summary: Yes: practical care, comfort and provision

cards.name: King of Pentacles
cards.upright: Mastery of the material world through successful leadership, business acumen, and generous abundance.
cards.reversed: Greed, corruption, or misuse of wealth and power for selfish or harmful purposes.

yes_no.summary: Yes: success, wealth and a foundation that holds
